module: Compiles and runs the custom electrical values declared in the jbeam (electrics.customValues: fields electricsName, electricsFunction, electricsDefault). Each expression is evaluated every frame in a sandboxed environment (math functions, round, clamp, smoothstep, case, pwm..., and a copy of `electrics`) then the result is copied back into electrics.values. Used only by electrics.lua.
notes: An expression has the form `electrics.<name> = <expression>`: assignments (isolated = sign) are refused inside the expression itself.
Variables available in the expression: electrics (copy of the current values), dt, math.* functions, dump, dumpz, round, square, clamp, smoothstep, smootherstep, smoothmin, sign, case, pwm, logValue.

case(selector, ...): with a boolean, acts as a ternary (true -> 1st argument, false -> 2nd); with a number n, returns the (n)th argument (1-based after floor, with n=0 returning the last one for lack of index 0), or the last argument if out of range.
pwm(input, frequency, dutyCycle, timeOffset): returns input when a normalized sine wave (frequency in Hz) exceeds 1 - dutyCycle, otherwise 0. The pwm time restarts at 0 every 3600 s.
logValue(value, label) prints the value and returns it (debugging aid).
Bug/anomaly: `pwm` is declared as a global function (function pwm without local), it leaks into the global environment of the vehicle VM.
If compilation of the whole block fails, updateCustomElectricsFunction stays nil and M.updateGFX will raise an error every frame (unprotected).
The 'electricsFunction' expression (literal value of a badly merged jbeam table header) is deliberately ignored.

compileCustomValueUpdates.desc: Builds the sandboxed environment, parses each custom value, initializes electrics.values with electricsDefault and compiles a single function running all the assignments.

returns.desc: Nothing (nil also if compilation fails, error logged).

resetCustomValues.desc: Puts back into electrics.values the electricsDefault values of all custom values (called at reset).

updateGFX.desc: Copies electrics.values into the environment, runs the compiled function then copies the custom keys back into electrics.values. Called by electrics.updateGFXSecondStep.
